variants.legacy: Original global receiver pinned to the HEAD at experiment creation; split payments unsupported.
variants.registered: Isolated immutable registered-percentage-route prototype; owner registers routes; cumulative revenue; no aggregate writes; no-argument batch payouts.

method: Two identical actual local Anvil Prague receipt runs for every supported scenario. EIP-170 remains enforced. Fixed fee is divisible by four so per-payment and cumulative 25% splits match exactly. Signed-address split payout costs sum both transactions. Legacy split values are null, never compared as equivalent. Failure contract fixtures use anvil_setCode outside measurements; individually unbounded signed-address gas-burning withdrawals use an explicit 300,000 transaction gas cap. Normal and registered-batch calls have a 16M transaction limit; registered callbacks retain their 100k contract cap. Registration and deployment are reported separately.

amortization.method: Projections, not 10/100-redemption executions. First cycle = one registration + fresh redemption + (N-1) pending-redemption samples + first full payout. Subsequent cycle = after-withdrawal redemption + (N-1) pending-redemption samples + repeat full payout. Signed-address split payouts sum two actual transactions; registered routes use one no-argument call. Collection deployment and NFT mint/unbox setup are excluded and reported separately. Signature bytes, token storage and calldata changes can alter exact future totals.
